mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.title, p.content_html, p.like_count, p.comment_count, p.collect_count, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, u.id AS author_id, u.username AS author_username, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar, IF(lk.id IS NOT NULL, TRUE, FALSE) AS is_liked, IF(fav.id IS NOT NULL, TRUE, FALSE) AS is_collected, IF(flw.id IS NOT NULL, TRUE, FALSE) AS is_followed FROM post p JOIN user u ON p.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user_like lk ON lk.target_id = p.id AND lk.target_type = 1 AND lk.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN user_favorite fav ON fav.post_id = p.id AND fav.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN user_follow flw ON flw.followed_id = p.user_id AND flw.follower_id = #{userId} WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
